description: Current preferences of one person, optionally in one context. Generated from tools/memory/preference.tool.json; drops superseded and expired records, ranks declared > observed > inferred, at most 50 rows plus one overflow sentinel.
name: mem_preferences

params.description: The crew:declared plane graph IRI (filled by cy from its plane table).
params.name: declared

params.description: The crew:records plane graph IRI (filled by cy from its plane table).
params.name: records

params.description: The crew:inferred plane graph IRI (filled by cy from its plane table).
params.name: inferred

params.description: Whose preference it is: a Person entity (IRI or local name). Empty string matches any.
params.name: person

params.description: Where it applies: email, chat, code-review, document, artifact, form or travel. Empty string matches any.
params.name: context

params.description: Current UTC instant (ISO-8601); records past expiresAt drop out.
params.name: now

template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?iri ?naturalKey ("preference" AS ?kind) ?label (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT STR(?b); separator=" | ") AS ?body) ?sourceKind ?recordedAt ?supersedes FROM <{declared}> FROM <{records}> FROM <{inferred}> WHERE { ?iri a aegis:Preference ; aegis:naturalKey ?naturalKey ; rdfs:label ?label ; aegis:sourceKind ?sourceKind ; aegis:recordedAt ?recordedAt ; aegis:prefers ?b . ?iri aegis:person ?f_person . FILTER('{person}' = '' || STR(?f_person) = '{person}') ?iri aegis:context ?f_context . FILTER('{context}' = '' || STR(?f_context) = '{context}') FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?iri aegis:supersededBy ?newer } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?iri aegis:expiresAt ?expires . FILTER(STR(?expires) < '{now}') } OPTIONAL { ?iri aegis:supersedes ?supersedes } BIND(IF(?sourceKind = "declared", 0, IF(?sourceKind = "observed", 1, 2)) AS ?rank) } GROUP BY ?iri ?naturalKey ?label ?sourceKind ?recordedAt ?supersedes ?rank ORDER BY ?rank DESC(?recordedAt) ?iri LIMIT 51
